title: Grateful Dead Live at Cumberland County Civic Center on 1982-09-17

ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix recording of a scorching fall‑82 show, highlighted by a smoking Morning Dew and monster The Other One.
ai_review.review: The tape captures an electric night from the Fall ’82 East Coast tour – the second set rolls with a sweet‑spicy mix that includes a blistering Morning Dew, a ferocious The Other One, and a tight Going Down the Road/US Blues finish.  Listeners rave about the crystal‑clear matrix mix and the band’s high energy throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews (9) give 4–5 stars, praising both performance and sound; show quality is consistently described as high‑energy with standout songs, while the recording is called awesome/perfect mix.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers call the mix “awesome,” “perfect,” and note a clean, balanced sound; no complaints about drop‑outs or muddiness were mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set ends with an interesting Throwing Stones→Deal transition; second set is described as sweet‑spicy, tight and full of high‑energy peaks.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Several reviewers note Jerry’s voice was strong ("Jerry sounds real good", "Jerry was great") despite occasional cracking that added character.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil’s bass work is repeatedly praised – “Phil rocked the place with bass all over the place,” and he even took vocal duties during The Other One.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob Weir’s rhythm guitar and vocals are mentioned positively, including his closing comment after the show.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland’s keyboard playing is highlighted as solid (“great keys”), though one reviewer notes his lack of backing vocals on this night.
